scope: Generic platform extensions. Kay UI and business policy stay in a separate repository.

upstreamReview.decision: Adopt native Agent owner chains, Session Agents, nullable Session titles, direct Drizzle storage and typed Developer tables. Preserve account fencing, exact call decisions and credential renewal in the native write paths. Keep Kay compatibility and old data conversion in its API and controlled migration job.

localExtensions.name: Identity provider scopes
localExtensions.behavior: The native OAuth SDK uses the configured scopes. Settings patches and repeated setup keep the saved scopes when the field is omitted.

localExtensions.name: Optional member signup
localExtensions.behavior: Authenticated accounts may join the explicitly configured organization as ordinary members only while an active Super Administrator exists. Suspended and removed accounts stay denied. Account IDs remain distinct.
